properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 1049356 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: LAUFER GROUP INTERNATIONAL
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1049356
Incident Time: 2013-05-25 11:35:00
Nearest City: Chippewa Falls, WI
Location: RAIL RAMP 1160 WEST RIVER ST.
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: POLYCHLORINATED BIPHENYLS
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: LAUFER GROUP INTERNATIONAL
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 44.927142, -91.410555 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 0.13 gallon
Report Description
***WEB REPORT*** LAUFER GROUP OFFERED A DRY 20 FOOT INTERMODAL CONTAINER SAID TO CONTAIN METAL SCRAP TO APL, LTD. THE CONTAINER WAS AN EXPORT LOAD BOOKED TO KARACHI, PAKISTAN. THE CONTAINER WAS AT THE CN RAIL RAMP IN CHIPPEWA FALLS, WI WHEN IT WAS DISCOVERED LEAKING APPROXIMATELY TWO CUPS OF AN OILY SUBSTANCE. THE CN TESTED THE SUBSTANCE AND THE FIELD TEST INDICATED THE SUBSTANCE CONTAINED PCB OF OVER 50 PPM. APL, LTD DEPLOYED A RESPONSE TEAM TO CONTAIN THE SUBSTANCE. THE CARGO WAS FOUND TO BE SMALL RECEPTACLES CONTAINING A OILY SUBSTANCE, NOT METAL SCRAP. THE RECEPTACLES WERE PLACED IN SALVAGE DRUMS AND THE CONTAINER CLEANED. A SECOND SAMPLE OF THE SUBSTANCE HAS BEEN SUBMITTED TO A LAB TO VERIFY THE SUBSTANCE AND THE PCB CONTENT. TEST RESULTS SHOULD BE AVAILABLE 6/07/2013.
